findings.finding: constant-step and strip-rank substitutes could fit all demonstrations yet change a query
findings.root_cause: the minimum lesson often exposed too few marked strips and repeated the same marker count
findings.repair: use four strips and the same marked ranks in both demonstrations while permuting counts 1/2/3

findings.finding: marker-span and side/rank lookup substitutes could fit the minimum lesson
findings.root_cause: contiguous marker caps made count correlate with span, while changing nuisance roles let lookup tables stand in for counting
findings.repair: hold dimensions/orientation/source side/ranks fixed, permute counts, and include a noncontiguous two-cell marker cap

final_bounded_result.limits: finite rival bank and seed range; not a proof of universal uniqueness
